# NEW 2026-11-21 v7.2 Stage 3 Package 1B, Silk Road Twin Phoenix (oe_srk_, slot 52). Generated by gen_silk_phoenix.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Any scope, monthly: called by scheduler slot 52 (gen_mainline_lock.py) or fallback pulse (oe_srk_pulse.txt).
# Idempotent per calendar month via oe_srk_ran_m. Respects SYS-1 oe_rule_is_silk_phoenix_* game rules.
oe_srk_monthly = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_m value = oe_srk_m_now }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_srk_ran_m ?= global_var:oe_srk_m } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_ran_m value = global_var:oe_srk_m }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_srk_init } } oe_srk_setup = yes }
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_srk_on }
            oe_srk_end_check = yes
            if = {
                limit = { has_global_variable = oe_srk_on current_date >= 1385.1.1 }
                if = { limit = { current_month = 1 } oe_srk_refresh_nodes = yes }
                oe_srk_refresh_mode = yes
                if = {
                    limit = { oe_srk_any_ready = yes }
                    oe_srk_ev_step = yes
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Any scope. First run: check SYS-1 game rule & date window.
oe_srk_setup = {
    set_global_variable = oe_srk_init
    if = {
        limit = { oe_srk_rule_enabled = no }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_done value = 9 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { current_date < 1535.1.1 }
        set_global_variable = oe_srk_on
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_done value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_mode value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_land_score value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_sea_score value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_legation value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_land_charter value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_sea_charter value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_scholars value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_guilds value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_faith value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_crisis value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_concordat value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_last value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_sent_cnt value = 0 }
        oe_srk_refresh_mode = yes
        oe_srk_refresh_nodes = yes
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_done value = 8 }
    }
}

# Any scope. Refresh Dual (1) vs Solo West (2) vs Solo East (3) vs Inactive (0).
oe_srk_refresh_mode = {
    if = { limit = { oe_srk_dual_ready = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_mode value = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_srk_solo_byz_ready = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_mode value = 2 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_srk_solo_chi_ready = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_mode value = 3 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_mode value = 0 } }
}

# Any scope, January. O(1) fixed-location check for Overland (0-4) and Maritime (0-3) Silk Road health.
oe_srk_refresh_nodes = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_land_score value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { location:constantinople = { owner ?= { at_war = no } } location:trebizond = { owner ?= { at_war = no } } } }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_land_score add = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { oe_srk_overland_open = yes location:tabriz = { owner ?= { at_war = no } } } }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_land_score add = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { location:samarkand = { owner ?= { at_war = no } } location:kashgar = { owner ?= { at_war = no } } } }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_land_score add = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_srk_yuan_ok = yes c:CHI = { owns = location:dadu } }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_land_score add = 1 }
    }

    set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_sea_score value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { location:constantinople = { owner ?= { at_war = no } } }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_sea_score add = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { location:alexandria = { owner ?= { at_war = no } } }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_sea_score add = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { oe_srk_zaytun_open = yes oe_srk_shibosi_active = yes location:jinjiang = { owner ?= { at_war = no } } } }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_sea_score add = 1 }
    }
}

# Any scope. End checks: 9 disabled by rule, 1 concordat completed, 3 timeout at 1535.1.1.
oe_srk_end_check = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_srk_rule_enabled = no }
        remove_global_variable = oe_srk_on
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_done value = 9 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_srk_done ?= 1 }
        remove_global_variable = oe_srk_on
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { current_date >= 1535.1.1 }
        remove_global_variable = oe_srk_on
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_done value = 3 }
    }
}

# Country scope. Apply a bilateral static modifier to root AND the sister empire when in Dual Mode.
oe_srk_apply_bilateral_mod = {
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = $mod$ months = $months$ mode = replace }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_srk_dual_active = yes }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:ROM NOT = { tag = ROM } }
            c:ROM = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = $mod$ months = $months$ mode = replace } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ NOT = { tag = BYZ } NOT = { country_exists = c:ROM } }
            c:BYZ = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = $mod$ months = $months$ mode = replace } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_srk_yuan_ok = yes NOT = { tag = CHI } }
            c:CHI = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = $mod$ months = $months$ mode = replace } }
        }
    }
}

# Any scope. Apply mutual opinion bias between ROM/BYZ and CHI when both exist.
oe_srk_apply_bilateral_bias = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_srk_yuan_ok = yes country_exists = c:ROM }
        c:ROM = { add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = c:CHI } }
        c:CHI = { add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = c:ROM } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_srk_yuan_ok = yes country_exists = c:BYZ }
        c:BYZ = { add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = c:CHI } }
        c:CHI = { add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = c:BYZ } }
    }
}

oe_srk_count = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_srk_sent_cnt } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_sent_cnt value = 0 } }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_sent_cnt add = 1 }
}

oe_srk_yc_trust = {
    oe_yc_add_trust = { amount = $amount$ }
}

oe_srk_fire_1 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_st_1 value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_ev_m value = oe_srk_m_now }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_last value = 1 }
    oe_srk_count = yes
    # Deliver to human protagonist first (ROM/BYZ or CHI); if both AI, deliver to active west host then CHI.
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:ROM c:ROM = { is_ai = no } OR = { oe_srk_dual_active = yes global_var:oe_srk_mode ?= 2 } }
        c:ROM = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_srk.1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { is_ai = no } OR = { oe_srk_dual_active = yes global_var:oe_srk_mode ?= 2 } }
        c:BYZ = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_srk.1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_srk_yuan_ok = yes c:CHI = { is_ai = no } OR = { oe_srk_dual_active = yes global_var:oe_srk_mode ?= 3 } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yuan_ev_m value = oe_srk_m_now }
        c:CHI = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_srk.1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:ROM OR = { oe_srk_dual_active = yes global_var:oe_srk_mode ?= 2 } }
        c:ROM = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_srk.1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ OR = { oe_srk_dual_active = yes global_var:oe_srk_mode ?= 2 } }
        c:BYZ = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_srk.1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_srk_yuan_ok = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yuan_ev_m value = oe_srk_m_now }
        c:CHI = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_srk.1 }
    }
}

# Any scope. Lapses missed events and dispatches at most one Twin Phoenix event per 6 months (and never double-fires same month).
oe_srk_ev_step = {
    if = { limit = { oe_srk_lapse_1 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_st_1 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_srk_lapse_2 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_st_2 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_srk_lapse_3 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_st_3 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_srk_lapse_4 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_st_4 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_srk_lapse_5 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_st_5 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_srk_lapse_6 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_st_6 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_srk_lapse_7 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_st_7 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_srk_lapse_8 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_st_8 value = 2 } }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_variable = oe_srk_m
            NOT = { global_var:oe_srk_ev_m ?= global_var:oe_srk_m }
            OR = {
                NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_srk_ev_m }
                global_var:oe_srk_m >= oe_srk_next_ev_m
            }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_pick value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_srk_pick ?= 0 oe_srk_open_1 = yes } random = { chance = 14 set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_pick value = 1 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_srk_pick ?= 0 oe_srk_open_2 = yes } random = { chance = 12 set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_pick value = 2 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_srk_pick ?= 0 oe_srk_open_3 = yes } random = { chance = 12 set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_pick value = 3 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_srk_pick ?= 0 oe_srk_open_4 = yes } random = { chance = 12 set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_pick value = 4 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_srk_pick ?= 0 oe_srk_open_5 = yes } random = { chance = 12 set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_pick value = 5 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_srk_pick ?= 0 oe_srk_open_6 = yes } random = { chance = 12 set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_pick value = 6 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_srk_pick ?= 0 oe_srk_open_7 = yes } random = { chance = 12 set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_pick value = 7 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_srk_pick ?= 0 oe_srk_open_8 = yes } random = { chance = 14 set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_pick value = 8 } } }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_srk_pick ?= 1 } oe_srk_fire_1 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_srk_pick ?= 2 } oe_srk_fire_2 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_srk_pick ?= 3 } oe_srk_fire_3 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_srk_pick ?= 4 } oe_srk_fire_4 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_srk_pick ?= 5 } oe_srk_fire_5 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_srk_pick ?= 6 } oe_srk_fire_6 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_srk_pick ?= 7 } oe_srk_fire_7 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_srk_pick ?= 8 } oe_srk_fire_8 = yes }
        remove_global_variable = oe_srk_pick
    }
}

# ---- TEST ONLY helpers (DEV_LINES srk* buttons)
oe_srk_test_ensure = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_srk_on } } set_global_variable = oe_srk_init set_global_variable = oe_srk_on set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_done value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_mode value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_land_score value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_sea_score value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_legation value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_land_charter value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_sea_charter value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_scholars value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_guilds value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_faith value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_crisis value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_concordat value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_last value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_sent_cnt value = 0 } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_m value = oe_srk_m_now }
    oe_srk_refresh_mode = yes
    oe_srk_refresh_nodes = yes
}
oe_srk_test_start = {
    oe_srk_test_clear = yes
    oe_srk_setup = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_srk_m value = oe_srk_m_now }
}
oe_srk_test_month = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_srk_ran_m } remove_global_variable = oe_srk_ran_m }
    oe_srk_monthly = yes
}

    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_srk_last } remove_global_variable = oe_srk_last }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_srk_pick } remove_global_variable = oe_srk_pick }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_srk_t_ev } remove_global_variable = oe_srk_t_ev }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_srk_sent_cnt } remove_global_variable = oe_srk_sent_cnt }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_srk_st_1 } remove_global_variable = oe_srk_st_1 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_srk_st_2 } remove_global_variable = oe_srk_st_2 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_srk_st_3 } remove_global_variable = oe_srk_st_3 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_srk_st_4 } remove_global_variable = oe_srk_st_4 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_srk_st_5 } remove_global_variable = oe_srk_st_5 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_srk_st_6 } remove_global_variable = oe_srk_st_6 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_srk_st_7 } remove_global_variable = oe_srk_st_7 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_srk_st_8 } remove_global_variable = oe_srk_st_8 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:ROM } c:ROM = { oe_srk_clear_country_vars = yes } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ } c:BYZ = { oe_srk_clear_country_vars = yes } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { oe_srk_clear_country_vars = yes } }
}
oe_srk_clear_country_vars = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_srk_job } remove_variable = oe_srk_job }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_srk_land_cd } remove_variable = oe_srk_land_cd }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_srk_sea_cd } remove_variable = oe_srk_sea_cd }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_srk_symp_done } remove_variable = oe_srk_symp_done }
}
